portal_description:
Rhythmbox is an integrated music management application based on the GStreamer media framework.

The gom packages provide an object mapper from GObjects to SQLite. They help to write applications that need to store structured data as well as make complex queries upon that data.

Grilo is a framework that provides access to different sources of multimedia content, using a pluggable system. The grilo package contains the core library and elements.

The grilo-plugins package contains plugins for grilo to get information from these sources:
  - Apple Trailers
  - Bookmarks
  - Euronews
  - Filesystem
  - Flickr
  - Freebox
  - Gravatar
  - iTunes Music Sharing
  - Jamendo
  - Last.fm
  - Local Metadata
  - Metadata Store
  - Pocket
  - Podcasts
  - Radio France
  - Shoutcast
  - The Guardian Videos
  - Tracker
  - Vimeo
  - Youtube

The totem packages contain a movie player that uses the GStreamer multimedia framework to play back films and music. It features a simple playlist, a full-screen mode, seek and volume controls, as well as complete keyboard navigation.

The totem-pl-parser library is a library for parsing and saving playlists as used in music and movie players.

The libdmapsharing packages implement DMAP (Digital Media Access Protocol) and provide client and server library for the protocol. The library implements DMAP. This also includes support for DAAP (Digital Audio Access Protocol) and DPAP (Digital Photo Access Protocol).

The compat-grilo02 package is a compatibility package with grilo 0.2 libraries.

The rhythmbox packages have been updated to version 3.4.1, the gom packages to version 0.3.2, the grilo packages to version 0.3.3, the grilo-plugins packages to version 0.3.4, the totem packages to version 3.22.1, the totem-pl-parser packages to version 3.10.7, and the libdmapsharing packages to version 2.9.37.

In addition, this update adds the compat-grilo02 package to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.4 Release Notes linked from the References section.
